s.note: Crisp fried risotto balls with peas, parmesan and a melting mozzarella centre, with warm tomato sauce
s.how: Cook 250g arborio rice in 750ml hot vegetable stock with 1 diced onion and 20g butter for 18 minutes, stir in 40g parmesan and 80g peas, spread out and chill 1 hour. Roll into 12 balls around cubes of 100g mozzarella, roll in flour, beaten egg and 100g breadcrumbs. Fry at 175C for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with 250ml warm passata simmered with garlic and basil.

s.n: Lucky Seven Tiger Bar hot honey wings
s.note: Crisp baked chicken wings tossed in hot honey butter with chilli, garlic and a squeeze of lemon
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wing pieces with 1 tbsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp garlic powder and bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 1 tsp chilli flakes and 2 tbsp hot sauce, add a squeeze of lemon, and toss the wings through.

m.note: Thin beef rolled around pecorino, garlic, parsley, pine nuts and prosciutto, slow-braised in tomato gravy, over soft polenta
m.how: Pound 4 thin slices beef topside (600g). Mix 60g pecorino, 40g breadcrumbs, 2 garlic cloves, a handful of parsley and 30g pine nuts. Lay prosciutto on each slice, spread with the filling, roll and tie. Brown in oil, soften 1 onion, add 1.4 litres passata and basil and simmer the rolls covered for 1 and a half hours. Cook 200g polenta in 1 litre water with 40g butter and 40g parmesan. Slice the braciole and serve over polenta with the gravy.

w.note: Light Italian baked ricotta cheesecake with lemon and orange zest and vanilla, dusted with icing sugar
w.how: Beat 900g ricotta with 150g caster sugar, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 orange and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time and 2 tbsp plain flour. Pour into a buttered and floured 23cm springform tin and bake at 160C for 1 hour. Cool in the turned-off oven with the door ajar for 1 hour, then chill 4 hours. Dust with icing sugar.

d.n: Lucky Seven Tiger Bar whisky sour
d.note: Rye whiskey shaken with lemon, sugar syrup and egg white to a soft foam, with aromatic bitters and a cherry
d.how: Dissolve 60g caster sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. Shake 180ml rye whiskey, 90ml lemon juice, the syrup and 1 egg white without ice, then again hard with ice. Strain into 4 glasses over ice, dot with bitters and add a cocktail cherry.
